stages.definition: Dominant step-sign share over nonzero steps; PERSISTENT when share >= 0.75 AND the full-window slope has a nonzero sign.
stages.abstentionSemantics: SHORT_HISTORY only. Data sufficiency and nothing else.
stages.directionDependency: A zero-signed full-window slope yields NOT_PERSISTENT, not abstention.

stages.definition: Bounded-interruption tolerance: PERSISTENT when support or directional consistency clears a candidate threshold and no opposing run exceeds the bound.
stages.abstentionSemantics: THREE reasons: SHORT_OR_MISSING_HISTORY (sufficiency), INDETERMINATE_DIRECTION (dominantSign === 0 || |slope| < .003 || support < .28), CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE (directionalConsistency < .62).
stages.directionDependency: A zero dominant sign or a near-flat slope yields abstention, not an answer.

stages.definition: Composes the STAGE 2I.3 head (BOUNDED_INTERRUPTION_TOLERANCE) into the assembly.
stages.spliceDescription: Wires the Stage 2I.3 head to a corpus carrying the Stage 2I.2 expectation. The head answers INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE where this corpus expects NOT_PERSISTENT, and neither party is internally wrong.

stages.definition: Label schemas only; no persistence implementation.
stages.abstentionSemantics: No abstention label declared in these schemas at all.
stages.note: Three independent stages declare a two-label persistence vocabulary with no INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE member, which is evidence that abstention was not intended as a routine persistence answer.

stages.abstentionSemantics: Recorded as "Emits INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE on its own account."
Unchanged. Recorded ABSTENTION_SEMANTICS_DIVERGENCE as the residual defect.

gateIntentEvidence: Stage 2I.3 introduced STABLE_NO_TREND and ALTERNATING_DIRECTION families expecting INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE in the same change as the gate. The head and its benchmark agree. No safety rationale, specification comment or documentation for the gate exists in the module.
defectOriginEvidence: Stage 2I.4 composes the Stage 2I.3 head with a corpus family carrying the Stage 2I.2 expectation (NOT_PERSISTENT on an alternating series). Every later stage inherited that pairing and scored the mismatch as head error.
